info.title: postit API
info.description: Self-hosted social publishing for a small team.

get.summary: Lists audit events, newest first, with optional filters.
get.description:
# Errors

Returns 403 for non-admins and 422 for invalid filters or paging.

parameters.name: actor_user_id
parameters.description: Only events performed by this user.

get.summary: Lists jobs, newest first, with optional filters.
get.description:
# Errors

Returns 403 for non-admins and 422 for invalid filters or paging.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound (RFC 3339) on the state's relevant timestamp.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound (RFC 3339) on the state's relevant timestamp.

get.summary: The recurring jobs with their last and next runs.

post.summary: Runs a recurring job now, outside its schedule.
post.description:
With an `Idempotency-Key`, a repeated request (a client or network retry) answers with
the first run's response instead of starting a second run.

# Errors

Returns 403 for non-admins and 404 for a name that is not a recurring job.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Replays the first response for a repeated key instead of starting a second run (24 h)

get.summary: Job counts per state, type and queue, and attempt throughput over a window.
get.description:
# Errors

Returns 403 for non-admins and 422 for a window outside 1-168 hours.

get.summary: One job with its attempt history.
get.description:
# Errors

Returns 403 for non-admins and 404 for an unknown job.

delete.summary: Deletes a finished job and its attempt history.
delete.description:
# Errors

Returns 403 for non-admins, 404 for an unknown job and 409 when the job has not finished
(`job_action_not_allowed`).

post.summary: Cancels a queued or scheduled job before it runs.
post.description:
# Errors

Returns 403 for non-admins, 404 for an unknown job and 409 when the job is not queued
(`job_action_not_allowed`).

post.summary: Re-runs a failed, dead, killed or cancelled job as a new job.
post.description:
# Errors

Returns 403 for non-admins, 404 for an unknown job and 409 when the job's state or type
does not allow a retry (`job_action_not_allowed`).

get.summary: Public OIDC settings the client needs to start a sign-in.
The caller's own profile. Reachable while the account is still pending approval.
get.description:
# Errors

Returns 401 without a valid token, 403 for a disabled account.

delete.summary: Starts deleting the caller's own account.
delete.description:
# Errors

Returns 403 while pending (or for a disabled or already-deleting account, which `Auth`
rejects first), 422 when the display name does not match, 409 for the last active admin.

get.summary: Lists users, filtered by status, role, and a name/email search, ordered by `sort`.
get.description:
# Errors

Returns 403 for non-admins and 422 for invalid filters or paging.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of display name or email.

get.description:
# Errors

Returns 403 for non-admins and 404 for an unknown id.

delete.description:
# Errors

Returns 403 for non-admins or self-deletion, 404 for an unknown id, 409 for the last
admin or a user already being deleted.

patch.summary: Changes one user's status or role (exactly one field per request).
patch.description:
# Errors

Returns 403 for non-admins, 404 for an unknown id, 409 for a user being deleted or the
last admin, and 422 for a malformed or disallowed change.

get.summary: Liveness probe: answers while the process is running.

get.description: Returns a 503 problem naming the first failing readiness check.

AttemptDto.description: One execution attempt of a job.

error_code.description: Code of the error, if it failed.

error_kind.description: Kind of the error, if it failed.

error_message.description: Error message, if the job type shows it.

AuditEventDto.description: One entry of the audit log.

oneOf.description: Who performed the action; none for system actions.

details.description: Event details. Every `*_user_id` value is a `UserRef` object.

ip.description: Client IP, until it is cleared by retention.

oneOf.description: Owner of the workspace the action touched.

request_id.description: `X-Request-Id` of the request that caused the event.

AuditEventKindDto.description:
Every audit event kind (`AuditEventKind` in `postit-data`); the `OpenAPI` enum the web
client's kind filter is typed from. Clients must tolerate values added later.

AuthConfigDto.description: What a client needs to start the OIDC sign-in.

client_id.description: OAuth client ID of the web and mobile clients.

issuer.description: Issuer URL of the identity provider.

DeleteMeRequest.description: Confirmation for deleting one's own account.

display_name.description: Must equal the caller's current display name.

ErrorCode.description: Machine-readable problem code (the `code` member of every problem+json body).

JobActionResponse.description: The job a retry or trigger created.

JobActionsDto.description: The console actions the job currently offers.

cancel.description: Cancel the job before it runs.

delete.description: Delete the job and its history.

retry.description: Re-run the job as a new job.

JobCountDto.description: A count under a key (state, type or queue).

key.description: The state, type or queue name.

JobDetailDto.description: A job with its attempt history and retry links.

retried_by.description: The job created to retry this one.

retried_from.description: The job this one is a manual retry of.

actions_disabled_reason.description: Why no action applies, when none does.

finished_at.description: When the job reached a final state.

recurring_name.description: Name of the recurring schedule that enqueued it.

run_at.description: When the job is (or was) due.

started_at.description: When the current or last attempt started.

JobStateDto.description: Where a job is in its life. Clients must tolerate values added later.

window_hours.description: Length of the throughput window in hours.

account_url.description: The identity provider's account page (`auth.oidc.account_url`), when configured.

Page_AuditEventDto.description: One page of results with its position in the full result set.

items.description: One entry of the audit log.

oneOf.description: Who performed the action; none for system actions.

details.description: Event details. Every `*_user_id` value is a `UserRef` object.

ip.description: Client IP, until it is cleared by retention.

oneOf.description: Owner of the workspace the action touched.

request_id.description: `X-Request-Id` of the request that caused the event.

total.description: Total number of items across all pages.

Page_JobDto.description: One page of results with its position in the full result set.

actions_disabled_reason.description: Why no action applies, when none does.

finished_at.description: When the job reached a final state.

recurring_name.description: Name of the recurring schedule that enqueued it.

run_at.description: When the job is (or was) due.

started_at.description: When the current or last attempt started.

total.description: Total number of items across all pages.

Page_UserDto.description: One page of results with its position in the full result set.

items.description: A postit user as admins and the user themselves see it. Profile fields come from the identity provider.

approved_at.description: When an admin approved the user.

approved_by.description: The admin who approved the user.

email.description: Email address from the identity provider, when it supplied one.

email_verified.description: Whether the provider verified the email address.

last_seen_at.description: When the user last made an authenticated request.

updated_at.description: When the user was last changed.

total.description: Total number of items across all pages.

ProblemDetails.description: The RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` body every error response carries.

request_id.description: The `X-Request-Id` of the failed request, for support.

title.description: Short summary of the problem type.

RecurringJobDto.description: A recurring job and its schedule.

last_run_at.description: When the newest run was scheduled.

next_run_at.description: When the next run is due.

ThroughputBucketDto.description: Attempt outcomes within one time bucket.

UserDto.description: A postit user as admins and the user themselves see it. Profile fields come from the identity provider.

approved_at.description: When an admin approved the user.

approved_by.description: The admin who approved the user.

email.description: Email address from the identity provider, when it supplied one.

email_verified.description: Whether the provider verified the email address.

last_seen_at.description: When the user last made an authenticated request.

updated_at.description: When the user was last changed.

UserRef.description:
A user reference in the audit log. `deleted` is true for a pseudonym left by user
deletion (a UUID v8, which postit never generates otherwise). `display_name` is the
user's current name, or null for a pseudonym or a user no longer present.

deleted.description: Whether the user has been deleted.

display_name.description: The user's current name, when known.

id.description: User ID, or the pseudonym that replaced it.
